### 1. Indonesian Economic News: Inflation Rises, BI-Rate Stable Amidst Rupiah Strengthening
- **Summary**: Indonesia's September 2026 inflation rate increased to 3.28% year-on-year from 3.19% in August, primarily driven by higher food prices due to El Niño and elevated global commodity prices, although core inflation saw a slight decrease to 2.84% (src_cd832889dc). Bank Indonesia maintained its BI-Rate at 5.75% in September 2026, a decision consistent with efforts to stabilize the Rupiah and keep inflation within the 2.5%±1% target (src_0ba9a5d054, src_98b104d81b). The Rupiah showed a marginal strengthening of 0.03% against the US Dollar, closing at Rp17,895 on October 6, 2026 (src_c48f564ee3).
